response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development skills and a broad technical background, but his experience is primarily in full-stack and web/mobile development rather than the specialized hardware and AI accelerator optimization required for this role. His work with low-latency systems and performance-sensitive applications (e.g., at Dunnhumby) is a positive signal, but there is limited evidence of direct experience with SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization.
strengths: Extensive experience with low-latency and high-performance systems (e.g., micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby).
Diverse technical background across multiple languages (Dlang, C/C++, TypeScript) and domains (embedded, web, mobile), showing adaptability.
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in technical communities, including workshops and talks on performance-related topics.
concerns: Lacks direct experience with SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, or AI accelerator optimization, which are core to the role.
Most recent work (e.g., at re:cinq and Optilyz) is focused on full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure, not hardware-software co-design.
No clear evidence of PhD or advanced degree in a relevant field, nor does the resume highlight equivalent professional experience in hardware optimization.
